facts.fact: ISO's member record states the Somali Bureau of Standards is a national standards body established by an Act of parliament (the Somali Standards and Quality Control law, Lr27) and operational since early 2020; the record gives no date, so the published date 2026-08-29 is used for the state of affairs.

systems.owner: Federal Republic of Somalia, board of ministry, Chamber of Commerce and agency representatives

note: No fact on certification: the bureau's mandate lists quality certificates and marks for goods and food, not certification against an IT or data standard, and names no certifier; no national IT or data standard is named.
